reviews.text: The staff is very helpful and caring.
Excellent staff and superb care for my pets. Highly recommend.
Amazing place! Front desk Service was great! Explained every detail thoroughly! Defenitely would go back

I can’t say enough amazing things about Biscayne Animal Hospital! Dr. Argiro, Dr. Goldstein, and Dr. Gonzalez are absolutely wonderful. They are all so caring, knowledgeable, and truly go above and beyond to make sure every pet receives the best care possible.

The entire staff is amazing, especially the front desk! Everyone is so kind, welcoming, helpful, and compassionate. From the moment you walk in, you feel comfortable and know that your pet is in good hands. The care and attention that everyone in the office provides is truly unmatched.

I’m so grateful to have such an amazing team taking care of my pet. Thank you to Dr. Argiro, Dr. Goldstein, Dr. Gonzalez, and the entire staff for everything you do!

Highly, highly recommend Biscayne Animal Hospital! 🐶❤️
Best place to take your animals! All of the doctors are wonderful and they have an amazing team😻 …

I highly recommend Biscayne animal hospital! Everyone here is so kind, caring, and professional. All of the doctors are wonderful and truly go above and beyond to make sure your pets receive the best care possible. You can tell they genuinely love what they do and care about their patients. We’re so grateful to have such an amazing team to take care of our pets! 🐾❤️

I highly recommend Biscayne Animal Hospital! They take excellent care of my pets and always make me feel confident that they are in the best hands. The entire team is very thorough, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring. They take the time to explain everything and make sure all of my questions and concerns are addressed.

I cannot recommend this place enough. From the moment you walk in, the staff is welcoming and kind. The veterinarians take the time to explain everything thoroughly, answer all your questions, and treat your pet with so much patience and gentle care. Truly top-tier service!
They took great care of my kitten! Thank you ☺️

Hi Luz, we’re sorry to see your one-star rating and would appreciate the opportunity to understand what prompted it. We take feedback about our hospital and patient care seriously, but we’re unable to locate a client or patient record associated with your name. Since your rating didn’t include any details about your experience, we’re unfortunately unable to determine what may have happened. If you have visited Biscayne Animal Hospital, please contact our team directly so we can identify your account and learn more about your concerns. We’d welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

If I could give Biscayne Animal Hospital 100 stars, I would.

For years, I brought my dog to a veterinarian on Miami Beach. About three years ago, I noticed that whenever I took my dog for a walk, he would scoot his backside across the grass and seemed to be in discomfort. I brought him to the vet to find out what was wrong, and I was told that he needed to have his anal glands expressed. This seemed to solve the problem, at least temporarily.

However, less than three weeks later, the problem returned. I brought him back to the vet, and once again, I was told that he needed to have his glands expressed. This cycle continued every three to four weeks for more than three years. Not only was it a significant financial burden for me, but watching my dog repeatedly go through the discomfort and stress was heartbreaking.

One day, I was discussing the situation with a dear friend, and she recommended Biscayne Animal Hospital. Making that appointment turned out to be one of the best decisions I have ever made.

Dr. Goldstein took a completely different approach. Instead of just simply treating the symptoms, he wanted to identify the underlying cause. He ran several tests and discovered that my dog was allergic to something in his food. Together, we developed a new dietary plan, and that changed everything.

It's like I have a brand-new dog. He is happier, healthier, and more playful than ever before. Most importantly, in the past two years, my dog has not needed to have his glands expressed a single time.

To say that Dr. Goldstein and his staff are amazing would be an understatement. I cannot recommend them highly enough. Dr. Goldstein has truly given my fur baby a brand new lease on life, and for that, I will be forever grateful.

100 out of 100 stars. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I don’t understand why anyone would board or leave their dog here overnight or even worst during the weekend. They close at 2pm Saturday and Sunday they are closed. Dogs cry and cry the entire weekend. It is awful. I asked the staff their protocol and they stated some dogs can be a little dramatic but someone comes to fed and walk them. How can anyone think putting your dog in a kennel all day and night to just be feed and taking to pee and poop when a person stops by is sufficient enough? It is devastating to hear how much the dogs want to be left out or taken care of while being in this hospital. There are so many other options to board your dog then just to drop them off in a place that isn’t even open sundays, closes at 2pm Saturdays and 6pm during the week.
Amazing experience with the staff and Dr. Goldstein from beginning to end.

A month ago, I had a wonderful time with Dr. Juana, an excellent professional! Unfortunately, today the Spanish-speaking receptionist was in a terrible mood. I had requested an appointment last Saturday, and according to her, there were none available. But the worst part was her attitude; she spoke to me rudely and angrily. It was so frustrating to waste my time, take Ubers, and be with my dogs and cat. I wouldn't go back to that place just because of the poor service. 🙃

I had an emergency with my dog, and when I arrived, the care was incredibly prompt and timely. Dr. Spencer explained everything to me perfectly, and the entire staff was fantastic. Highly recommend them!
Everyone at this facility is on their game and ready to help and to ease your fears regarding any problems with your pets they treat you and your pets like they really care
This place really cares about the animals! The staff is great and Dr. Goldstein really explains and takes his time with your pet! Very knowledgeable and kind! A++++

Dr. Goldstein
Takes the time to explain everything and is very passionate on his approach to your concerns. His staff is one of a kind and very helpful. The Moreschi Family! Wishes you and your staff a Happy Holidays 😀
Great staff and the best Vets in Miami . I have taken my dogs to Biscayne Animal Hospital since 2001 .

EDIT: "Like all medical professionals..." No, I don't think so. There should be someone answering the phone during business hours. Refusing to hire more vets to handle the influx of patients is also not a good business practice. If you're constantly making people wait even though they have appointments, then you're doing something wrong. Period. I stand by my review.
----
Tired of businesses acting like they deserve money for doing nothing.
Every time I've been, despite having an appointment, I've been made to wait for long periods of time. My dog had an emergency and I called during their business hours. They had an automated message saying they were on lunch break.
Seriously? Did every single person leave?
On top of that, they never bothered to call me back.
I went to another vet, and I was able to make an appointment the same day, they saw me immediately when I came in, and they were very proactive with getting my dog help. They even called me afterward to give me an update on something we had discussed.
There are better options than this place.
Love Biscayne Animal Hospital, Dr. Goldstein and his incredible staff! They truly care about our pets!

Always a great experience at BAH, Staff is friendly and remembers pets name when they see me. Gentle care is always taken with my babies during their visits- scheduled or unscheduled. Highly recommended.

All support staff excellent and all of the Vets (especially Dr. Spencer Goldstein) are incredibly competent and kind!  Location of their offices is also fantastic. They make me and my dogs feel like we are their most important customer every time we are there. Recommend to everyone I know that needs their services!

Dr. Goldstein has been looking after my cat and my mother's animals for years and he is the BEST. I've been to other vets before, with previous animals, and none compare to Dr. Goldstein. He knows what he is talking about, very patient, kind and I trust him. His staff and technicians are also great. Highly recommend going to this practice.
Biscayne Animal Hospital is a great clinic , all are very attentive , willing to assist you and Dr. Goldstein is amazing . Sarah at the front desk is very professional.
Best animal hospital in Miami. Amazing staff! Very helpful and kind. Bringing both my dogs here moving forward!

Wonderful care for our pets. Sometimes there is a wait, but one has to consider that there might be an emergency. We are very satisfied with the care that our pets receive. Our senior pets, are doing well because of the expert care that they receive from Dr. Goldstein. I wouldn't take my pets to any other veterinarian.

Very disappointing service.
I came in with my dog needing help with her anal glands, and they refused to take her in. I expected help and compassion, especially because my little dog was extremely uncomfortable and itching a lot. It’s something super quick, anal gland expression takes less than 10 minutes  and they still refused to help her.

I ended up going to GoodVets, who were also about to close, and they immediately took care of her with amazing customer service. It was my first time there and they were incredibly kind.

Avoid going to a place where they don’t care about your pet’s well-being
The staff is so friendly and the vets are great!  My dog loves going there!
Dr. Argiro is the best! She saved our dog from hemorrhagic gastroenteritis. She is very knowledgeable, caring and kind. The front staff is very nice as well! Highly recommend!

Very disappointing experience.
I went just to have my cat’s wound checked and the bandage changed. I specifically asked for an estimate before any service, but they took him in and came back with a long list of unnecessary tests totaling over $1,000 — without even examining the wound first. When I refused, they still charged me $100 for a “consultation.”

Also, it’s not true that I refused sedation or the bandage change. What I declined was an ECG, a liver test, and a full blood panel that had nothing to do with why I was there. At the end, the front desk made me sign a document saying they didn’t perform any procedure — yet they still charged me.
If nothing was done, why am I paying for a consultation? I only needed the bandage checked, and I already had all the test results from the urgent care that treated my cat two days earlier.

It feels like a money-driven clinic, not one focused on the pet’s actual well-being.
I have no complaint. This hospital has always provided the best service for my pet. The cost was a bit pricey but the service has the bar set high. I highly recommend this animal hospital.

I would recommend Dr. Goldstein and his staff any day without hesitation.
The only reason my dog is alive today is because of Dr. Goldstein.
My dog received spinal surgery about a year and a half ago. Dr. Goldstein identified the issue and got personally involved in getting Max an appointment with the very sought after surgeon who saved his life.
After Max's surgery the staff at Biscayne Animal Hospital was constantly following up on Max's progress.
Every time we have had appointments the staff at the clinic has been kind and courteous and the treatment of my dog has always been gentle and loving.
The costs of procedures and visits are always discussed upfront, and the staff even provides suggestions as to how I can make the best decision for my dog while remaining cost effective.
I would never settle for less than the best for Max, and he receives the best treatment from Dr. Goldstein and everyone else at Biscayne Animal Hospital.
Dr. Goldstein and his team are the best around. They care for their patients and pets owners at the highest level. We've been customers for 25 plus years and would never go anywhere else.
Full review is coming soon

Excellent personal service for our Coton Coco.  Both Dr. Goldstein and staff are most attentive in their care of Coco; excellent communication with her owner, Allen Benowitz. I highly recommend Biscayne Animal Hospital.
Dr. Goldstein and staff have always been caring, compassionate and accommodating in providing what I believe to be the best care my dogs have ever received for the past 18 years.
Dr. G is a fabulous and caring Dr. His staff is excellent as well.

The veterinarians here are exceptional, and the staff couldn't be friendlier or more responsive. I have a senior dog with several health issues and he has received such thoughtful, comprehensive and collaborative care here. A++

I had a fantastic visit nothing could have or should have been done differently. I have a very challenging behavioral dog and Dr Goldstein and his staff are one of the few vets offices that will even treat her let alone make it a favorable experience so that she's never traumatized.

Took my dog Mars to Biscayne Animal Hospital over the weekend for his pre-surgical bloodwork and exams before his neuter next month, and the experience was wonderful. The staff was so sweet and patient with him, and everything was handled professionally from start to finish. I really appreciate how caring and attentive they were — couldn’t have asked for a better visit!

Dr. Goldstein and Dr. Arana are cream of the crop. They provide highly individualized, specialty care and are very attentive when we visit. The team always follows up with calls and texts after procedures and they are incredibly responsive. The docs and techs are intentional about spending time with us and our babies to provide reassurance, encouragement and education each visit. We've never felt rushed or invalidated with any concerns we have had over the past two years. Vet techs and front desk team are super as well. We feel so supported and our golden girls (two totally weirdo gorgeous mutts) are staying healthy with the support of the team. My dad took all of his babies (tons of cats and a Chow) there my whole life before he passed. We won't go anywhere else. Ashley, Keanan, Florence and Vashti.
